description:
A neat little application that allows you to draw on your screen

iScribby is a screen-drawing application: use it anywhere — on your desktop, while browsing the internet, or even in a video game — to draw, highlight, and annotate directly on the screen during presentations, streams, and lessons.
- Fix - selection region issue involving images that caused an image to relocate unnecessarily.
- Added the ability to steal focus using ALT + F shortcut, to allow users to sort out scenarios where another app is interfering with the cursor - a common issue in first person shooters.
- Added a view button in general settings for opening settings file folder.
- Made freezeframe background option into a standalone setting that can be used separately with a Shift + F shortcut.
- Updated freezeframe setting to now freeze the screen immediately instead of doing so on the next draw mode trigger.
